The '''Artorias communication center''' handled electronic communications between the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Artorias]] and the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the center's [[Comm station/Legends|comm interlink]] had been damaged, and resulted in knocking the station offline. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named [[Sparky (Human)|Sparky]] was assigned the task of fixing the interlink but was unsuccessful. Sparky desperately sought the assistance of a [[Dulac|cloaked man]] who pretended to fix it but did nothing since he was an advance agent of a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] fleet. During the [[Battle of Artorias|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]] of Artorias, the communications center was left offline, therefore preventing communications between the planet and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
